title: Test conventions and coverage
preamble:
# Test conventions and coverage

Test infrastructure and conventions for libds's two test
suites — `impl/` (white-box, internal headers) and `spec/`
(black-box, public-API only) — and, in its last section, how
every DS product's test coverage is measured and held.

The structural conventions in [ITST.5] apply to both suites.
Spec-specific discipline (what's unique about how spec tests
are scoped) lives in [ISTS].

## What this is not

- Not the spec-suite-specific discipline. See [ISTS].
- Not a benchmark / perf-test doc.
